increments.words: 今晚必须完成P1的设计（设计 + 做出来）。P1：语音回复（Argmax TTS）、一起深呼吸、安全兜底（988）、一键清空；P2的本地记忆如果有时间可以设计。先验收 P0，再做 P1。另问：是否加入 sidechat，类似于额外的聊天窗口（解决上下文管理问题）

build: voice reply: auto-read each reply in its language (Argmax Qwen3-TTS, resident, warmed), speaker toggle to mute
deep breathing: offered after an anxious (unpleasant-high) turn via a button; companion breathes in 4 s / out 6 s × 3, stoppable
988 safety: gentle mention in the reply + a calm card (988 call/text, 911 emergency) when crisis content is detected
one-click clear: clears log and history, companion neutral, 'cleared' hint, no confirm
poke: click/Enter on the companion → playful reaction animation, varied on repeats, reduced-motion fallback
custom name: edit the companion's name in place, saved locally, used by Bonsai when it refers to itself
design_only: local memory: mood history + 'about you' summary across sessions with opt-in and forget-me (P2)
